title: Disco Inferno
description: A chaotic surreal scene features a large reflective disco ball suspended in a dark, smoky space. Flowing satin fabrics in vibrant blue, gold, and rust swirl dynamically around several dancing figures in ornate golden and red costumes, surrounded by dramatic smoke and fiery light.
prompt: Surreal baroque scene with a large sparkling disco ball hanging in a dark smoky void. Dynamic flowing satin drapery in electric blue, bright gold, and deep rust swirls around multiple dancers wearing ornate golden and red costumes. Dramatic lighting, theatrical composition, swirling smoke and fabric, high contrast, painterly digital art style.
